name: Barthold
source:
"Lazing around at home while the girl is working. You guys are the worst men ever."

A masked man who works as a special representative for the Piskis Republic.
He allows the protagonist's group who are fleeing from the Veke Kingdom into his country and helps them make arrangements for living.
He never lets people see his face, but his skill in politics is very good and the citizens greatly trust him.

[spoiler]He is actually King Balthazar of Fasan, who faked his death and went into hiding.[/spoiler]
